items.quote: He participated in prototyping novel ideas for frontline staff as a team member.
He delivered his share of bilateral negotiations on the water agreement reliably.
He drove a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading for the whole division.
He took ownership of explaining the new scheme on radio and at town halls and steered it to completion.
